title: Record the logarithm absorption bound
body:
## Summary
- The series for `exp(1/2)` stays below 2, so `ln 2 > 1/2`, and together with `exp(u) >= u^2/2` this gives `log2(y)^2 <= 8y`.
- For every integer `n >= 1`, `n+2 <= 3n`, so `log2(n+2)^2 <= 24n`. The integer form `ceil(log2(n+2))^2 <= 24n` holds for every `n` through `2^24`.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
